caption: The drawing depicts a large eagle with outstretched wings, colored in shades of gold and brown. The eagle's beak is yellow with a red interior, and its talons are light yellow with red accents on the claws. The eagle is perched on a series of black and dark brown rocks. In front of its body, the eagle holds a shield featuring a design with alternating red and white vertical stripes and a blue top section adorned with white stars. The background of the image is a semi-circular field painted blue, with visible signs of wear and some lighter patches, bordered by the arc of the composition. The entire scene is displayed on a light, off-white background.
title: Sternpiece: Eagle
